_about: D. H. Lawrence. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Complete Poems; Complete Short Stories; Sons and Lovers; Studies in Classic American Literature; The Rainbow; Women in Love. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

lawrence-collected-poems: The Collected Poems of D. H. Lawrence, [vol. II] Unrhyming Poems
lawrence-woman-who-rode-away: The Woman Who Rode Away and Other Stories

lawrence-collected-poems.year: 1929 (title page: New York, Jonathan Cape and Harrison Smith, 1929; 'First published in the United States, 1929')
lawrence-collected-poems.evidence: Read title page and start (Look! We Have Come Through!); the scan holds only the Unrhyming Poems volume (Look! We Have Come Through!, Birds Beasts and Flowers); not lending.
lawrence-collected-poems.case: Bloom lists the Complete Poems. Lawrence's own Collected Poems (1928; US edition 1929) is US-PD. Vol. II is on IA. For the rhyming poems of vol. I, use the separate PG volumes (Love Poems, Amores, New Poems, Bay 22734), which hold the same poems.
lawrence-collected-poems.note: Pansies (1929) and Nettles (1930) are PD but not found here. Last Poems (1932) and the posthumous material in the Complete Poems are NOT PD. Lawrence revised his early poems for the 1928 Collected, so the PG volumes give the earlier versions.
